name: basic skirt sloper
source: adapted from Pattern Making for Fashion Design, 5th ed. (Helen Joseph-Armstrong), "Skirt Draft," p.48-50
notes: Dart placement (how far each dart sits from center front/back) is estimated by spacing darts evenly across the waist, since the source book's exact placement value wasn't available.
The waistline and side-seam curves are smooth mathematical approximations of the book's hand-drafting curve tool, not a literal reproduction of its shape.
